title: Beast2Py
description: Beast2Py is a Python framework for reproducible divergence time estimation with BEAST2: declarative YAML configuration, calibration prior specification and conflict detection, three-gate validation, prior sensitivity analysis, analysis fingerprints, generated LaTeX methods descriptions, and pipeline generation. Beast2Py itself is MIT-licensed; the bundled BEAST2 package-management helper classes are LGPL-2.1 (see NOTICE in the repository).
